decision: A fixture per-bundle list that matches no registry version takes the smallest covering version (Task Manager v1 for task.read, Project Access v1 for project.read, Document Registrar v1 for document.read); Task and Project Approver per-bundle fields are dropped, Project, Client and Document per-bundle fields stay beside their grants
why: No migrated screen reads the extra permissions except task.manage and project.lifecycle.transition/project.close, handled below; unmigrated screens still read the unchanged Project, Client and Document per-bundle fields

decision: Component tests that prove a narrowed reader (task.read without task.manage, lifecycle transition without close) build that grant by hand; the current Actor parser refuses it, so App-level journeys that served such a reader now serve a Task Manager with a read-only listing
why: Keeps every assertion: the screens still check each permission on its own, and the App journeys keep their no-management-read assertions through an immutable listing

decision: A malformed per-bundle Task capture (no assignment, unsupported version) becomes a readCurrentActor refusal of the whole Actor
why: The parser refuses such a grant for the whole Actor (#1332), as #1381 did for Internal Tasks
